Caroline, 9, and Zoe, 12, will appear on limited-edition Well Market snack packaging, and each winner's nonprofit soccer organization will receive a $25,000 grant

WOONSOCKET, R.I., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CVS Pharmacy®, the retail division of CVS Health® (NYSE: CVS), and its Well Market® store brand consumables line today named Caroline, age 9, of Holmes Beach, Florida, and Zoe, age 12, of Los Angeles, California, the Grand Prize winners of the first CVS Home Team Heroes soccer contest. The nationwide contest recognizes young soccer players making a meaningful difference in their communities.

Each winner will receive a $25,000 grant for their nonprofit soccer organization, be featured on limited-edition packaging for select Well Market® snacks, CVS Pharmacy's store brand consumables line, and celebrate with a block party for their team. The limited-edition packaging will help bring the winners' stories to a broader audience when it arrives on select CVS Pharmacy shelves in 2027.

"Caroline and Zoe perfectly represent what we set out to celebrate through Home Team Heroes: young players who are showing up for others and making their communities stronger," said Mike Wier, Vice President of Store Brands at CVS Health. "Their stories demonstrate how the values built through soccer can extend far beyond the field. We're proud to recognize their impact, support the soccer organizations they selected to help more young people play, connect and thrive, and share their stories with a broader audience through Well Market."

Jordyn Bugg, Seattle Reign defender, surprised Caroline and Zoe with the news via video.

"Getting to tell Caroline and Zoe they're CVS Home Team Heroes was one of the best moments of my year. I started on a local field with coaches and teammates who believed in me, and it's really special to see these two show up for the players and communities around them," said Bugg. "I can't wait to walk into a CVS and see their faces on the shelf."

Echoing that sentiment, Croix Bethune, Kansas City Current midfielder, celebrated the winners and the impact they're making in their communities.

"Caroline and Zoe show what being a true team player is all about," said Bethune. "I'm honored to be part of sharing their stories and can't wait to see what the future holds for them."

Meet the Home Team Heroes

Caroline, 9, Holmes Beach, Florida
Caroline plays for The Center of Anna Maria Island's youth soccer program in Holmes Beach, Florida. After two hurricanes devastated the Center, Caroline and her older brother, Parker, started Print Wizards, selling 3D-printed toys to raise money for the organization. The siblings have raised more than $6,000 to help repair the fields and establish an all-girls soccer team.

For Caroline, soccer is a place to build camaraderie, confidence and leadership skills alongside her teammates. The Center of Anna Maria Island will use its $25,000 grant to continue rebuilding, support local families affected by the hurricanes and expand youth sports programming so more children can play.  

"As Caroline's parents, we're so proud to see her enthusiasm for her all-girls flag football and soccer team and her business, Print Wizards, recognized through CVS Home Team Heroes," said Brooke and Mike Svoboda. "At nine years old, she's discovering how her ideas can bring people together, and this support means so much to her and our family. It encourages her to keep dreaming big and making a difference in her community."

Zoe, 12, Los Angeles, California
Zoe plays for Tudela Fútbol Club Los Angeles in Los Angeles, California. Born with progressive hearing loss, she serves as a role model for children who are deaf or hard of hearing, regularly meets with newly diagnosed infants and their families, and speaks on student panels to share her experience. Zoe hopes to inspire other deaf soccer players by one day playing for the U.S. Women's Deaf National Team.

Tudela Fútbol Club Los Angeles will use its $25,000 grant to help make soccer more accessible by bridging gender and opportunity gaps and challenging the typical pay-to-play model.

"Discovering the U.S. Women's Deaf National Team gave Zoe something she had been missing: the chance to see herself reflected in the athletes she admired. Through USA Deaf Soccer, she found the confidence to embrace who she is, and when she arrived at her first Tudela FC tryout, someone greeted her in sign language — a simple gesture that showed her she belonged," said Angie Winslow, Zoe's mother. "We're incredibly proud to see Zoe now extending that same spirit of inclusion to younger athletes, and grateful that CVS is celebrating the power of a game that truly belongs to everyone."

What's next for Home Team Heroes
The celebration of this year's Home Team Heroes will continue into 2027. Two Runners-Up will be announced in early 2027, and CVS Pharmacy will visit the Grand Prize winners' hometowns to produce a video series highlighting their stories. The first episode is expected to debut in January. Limited-edition Well Market snacks featuring the winners are anticipated to arrive on CVS Pharmacy shelves in select markets in spring 2027, while supplies last.

Supporting youth soccer in communities
Home Team Heroes builds on CVS Health's broader, multi-year commitment to expanding access to play and supporting healthier communities through soccer. Through community field projects and programs that recognize young athletes making a difference, CVS Health is helping create more opportunities for young people to play.

CVS Health has supported community field projects in collaboration with the Alex Morgan Foundation in Diamond Bar, California, and Secaucus, New Jersey; as well as projects in Vancouver, Washington; Kansas City, Missouri; and Garfield Park in Washington, D.C.

Learn more about our Home Team Heroes winners and their stories at https://www.cvs.com/content/soccer/home-team-heroes. To learn more about how CVS Health is supporting its communities through soccer, visit cvs.com/content/soccer.

About CVS Health
CVS Health is a leading health solutions company simplifying health care one person, one family and one community at a time. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had approximately 9,000 retail pharmacy locations, more than 1,000 walk-in and primary care medical clinics and a leading pharmacy benefits manager with approximately 87 million plan members. The Company also serves an estimated 37 million people through a broad range of health insurance products and related services. The Company's integrated model uses personalized, technology driven services to connect people to simply better health, increasing access to quality care, delivering better outcomes, and lowering overall costs.

MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Graco Inc. (NYSE: GGG) today announced that Michael Garceau has been appointed as President, Expansion Markets Division, effective Dec. 1, 2026.

Garceau brings more than 20 years of leadership experience across industrial businesses, with a strong track record of driving growth, improving business performance and developing new markets. Most recently, he served as President of Honeywell Safety Products following its acquisition by PIP Global Safety, leading the $1 billion business through its transition and integration. Previously, Garceau was President of Honeywell’s Personal Protective Equipment business, where he led a significant business transformation that improved growth and operational performance.

“Expansion Markets is an important part of Graco’s strategy to accelerate growth beyond our core businesses, and Michael brings the experience and leadership to help us move forward with focus and speed,” said Mark Sheahan, Graco’s President and CEO. “We see meaningful opportunities in areas like data centers and adjacent markets where Graco’s technology, capabilities and business model can create differentiated value for customers.”

Garceau succeeds Tim White as President of the Expansion Markets Division, following White’s appointment to lead Graco’s new Integration Management Office, which was established to strengthen acquisition integration and support the company’s broader growth strategy.

Garceau holds an MBA in Marketing and General Management from the University of Michigan’s Ross School of Business and a BSBA from the University of Akron.

It designs, manufactures and markets systems and equipment to move, measure, control, dispense and spray fluid and powder materials. Tim Richey

In partnership with existing capital markets professionals, they will form Cushman & Wakefield’s institutional capital markets team in Denver, working to expand the firm’s office and multifamily investment sales capabilities across the Mountain West region.

“We’re extremely pleased to welcome a team of this caliber to bolster our capital markets platform. Tim, Cartter and Jack bring exceptional transaction experience, deep institutional relationships and a comprehensive understanding of the region’s investment landscape,” said Miles Treaster, President, Americas Capital Markets at Cushman & Wakefield. “Their addition reinforces our commitment to investors and owners, both across the Mountain West and beyond, as we connect global clients with local experts to achieve their objectives.”

Tim Richey and Berg will partner with Aaron Johnson, Executive Director in Denver, to lead institutional office sales and with Pat Knowlton, Executive Director in Colorado Springs, to lead institutional multifamily sales. Jack Richey will support both product types alongside the broader Denver capital markets team.

“As capital markets conditions evolve, investors are looking for ways to take advantage of the next cycle. Denver is well positioned for continued growth, and we see a strong opportunity to expand our presence in the market,” said Steve Schwab, Managing Principal of Cushman & Wakefield’s Denver office. “Tim, Cartter and Jack bring the experience and relationships to help us do that. Working alongside Aaron Johnson, Pat Knowlton and our broader team, they’ll strengthen our ability to serve institutional clients across the office and multifamily sectors.”

Tim Richey returns to Cushman & Wakefield as Executive Vice Chair and is widely recognized as one of the Rocky Mountain Region's leading institutional office capital markets advisors. Over his 30-plus year-career, he has closed more than $20 billion in transaction value and advised on approximately 70% of the high-rise office sales across the Denver skyline.

Most recently, he served as Executive Vice Chairman with Newmark's Capital Markets division in Denver, following previous leadership roles at CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield and Grubb & Ellis. His return brings deep market expertise, longstanding client relationships and a proven track record of delivering outstanding results for institutional investors across Colorado and the broader region.

Cartter joins as Executive Managing Director and brings more than 16 years of experience across investment sales, joint ventures and capital markets advisory. He has completed more than $20 billion in transactions spanning office, multifamily, life science, retail and hospitality assets throughout the Mountain West and beyond. Cartter previously led acquisitions at BMC Investments and prior to that spent 14 years with Eastdil Secured, where he helped establish the firm's Denver office and advised institutional investors across the western United States.

Jack Richey joins as Director and brings nearly seven years of investment sales experience spanning office, multifamily, industrial, land, and debt and structured finance. Over the past three years, he has been directly involved in more than $600 million in transactions.

Black Friday offer and holiday promo codes aimed at the half of U.S. shoppers planning to give an experience this season

FORT WORTH, Texas, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sports Entertainment Gaming Global Corporation ("SEGG Media" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: SEGG) today announced that TicketStub.com will relaunch on a new platform on November 25, at the start of the holiday shopping season. TicketStub.com will open with a Black Friday offer, with details to be announced closer to launch, and will release promo codes for discounted tickets throughout the holidays.

Half of U.S. holiday shoppers plan to give an experience this year, up from 39% in 2024, and 19% plan to give tickets to an event, according to Deloitte's 2026 Holiday Retail Survey. The same survey found that 47% of shoppers would rather give one meaningful, higher-cost gift than several smaller ones. On the receiving side, concert tickets ranked second only to a full trip among the experiences Americans most wanted as a holiday gift, cited by 51% of respondents in a 2025 Talker Research survey of 5,000 adults commissioned by Chime.

Demand for live events is running at record levels. Live Nation Entertainment reported selling 170 million concert tickets through October 2026, up 13% year over year and already ahead of its total for all of 2025.

TicketStub.com gives users access to thousands of events around the world and earns revenue through service fees. The Company plans to add advertising and promoted listings as the platform develops. The relaunch follows the worldwide relaunch of Lottery.com on November 18 and is supported by the strategic financing commitments SEGG Media announced on November 12.

"Veloce's channels draw more than 500 million views a month from fans who follow racing, gaming and live sport. That's an audience that goes to live events, and putting TicketStub.com in front of them is our first priority," said Gregory Potts, Chief Operating Officer of SEGG Media. "We also plan to add an ongoing sweepstakes where users can win free tickets, concert experiences and other live event prizes. Along with the Black Friday offer and holiday promo codes, it gives fans a reason to keep coming back to TicketStub.com."

SEGG Media (Nasdaq: SEGG, LTRYW) is a global sports, entertainment, and gaming group operating a portfolio of digital assets including Sports.com, Concerts.com, TicketStub.com, Lottery.com, and Veloce Media Group. Focused on immersive fan engagement, ethical gaming, and AI-driven live experiences, SEGG Media is redefining how global audiences interact with the content they love.

Regina, Saskatchewan--(Newsfile Corp. - November 20, 2026) - Above Food Ingredients Inc. (OTC: ABVEF) ("Above" or the "Company") announces today that its Business Combination Agreement with Palm Global Technologies Limited, UK ("Palm Global") dated May 16, 2025 (the "BCA"), and the related letter agreement dated December 31, 2025, have been discontinued. The proposed reverse merger between the Company and Palm Global will not proceed.

The BCA is not moving forward because Palm Global was unable to complete the due diligence required. Despite repeated requests, the Company did not receive evidence of those transfers, and without that verification the transaction could not proceed. No termination fee is payable by the Company.

Above Food continues to maintain the good relationship with all preferred partners like Promax Investments ("Promax") regarding potential opportunities to cooperate going forward.

The Company is also pursuing repayment of the amounts it advanced to Palm Global in connection with the transaction.

"We pursued this transaction in good faith, but we could not proceed without being able to complete the due diligence," said Lionel Kambeitz, Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Above Food. "We value our relationship with preferred partners and look forward to our continuing discussions as we focus on our core agriculture and food security business."

The Company's common shares continue to trade on the OTC Market under the symbol ABVEF.

VANCOUVER, BC and GLIL YAM, Israel, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- IM Cannabis Corp. (the "Company") (NASDAQ: IMCC) announced changes to its management and board of directors (the "Board"), including the appointment of Ronen Zalayet as Chief Executive Officer and Ohad Melnik as an independent director.

Management Changes

Effective November 19, 2026, the Board appointed Ronen Zalayet as Chief Executive Officer of the Company, succeeding Oren Shuster, who resigned from that role.

Mr. Zalayet has more than 25 years of experience in financial leadership positions in private and public companies. He has served as Chief Financial Officer of Nexera Technologies Ltd. (formerly Jeffs' Brands Ltd.), a company listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq"), since October 2022. From July 2021 to December 2023, he served as Chief Executive Officer and a director of Shemen Oil and Gas Resources Ltd., a company listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. From July 2025 to June 2026, he served as Chief Financial Officer of Fort Technology Inc., a Canadian company listed on Nasdaq (formerly Impact Acquisition Corp.). From November 2019 to June 2021, Mr. Zalayet served as Chief Financial Officer of Colugo Systems Ltd., and from 2016 to 2020, he served as a consultant, a director and head of the Israeli office of Access Capital Markets Limited. Mr. Zalayet holds a B.A. in Economics and Accounting and an M.B.A. from Tel Aviv University and is a certified public accountant in Israel.

The Board thanks Mr. Shuster for his leadership of the Company since its founding and for his many contributions and welcomes Mr. Zalayet as Chief Executive Officer.

In addition, effective November 19, 2026, Shakked Shuster was appointed as Chief Executive Officer of Focus Medical Herbs Ltd., the Company's Israeli subsidiary through which it operates its medical cannabis business in Israel, succeeding Oren Shuster following his resignation from that role. 

Mr. Shakked Shuster has more than six years of experience in Israel's medical cannabis industry through his work at the Company, spanning product, international sourcing, brand partnerships and marketing. He joined the Company in July 2020 as Product Marketing Lead before taking on the role of Product Manager from 2021 to 2022. In that role, he set the Company's product and quality standards and spent an extended period working with the team at its southern cultivation facility. Key Terms

scope 1technical
Scope 1 are the greenhouse gas emissions a company produces directly from sources it owns or controls, like fuel burned in company vehicles, boilers, or on-site factories. Think of it as the smoke coming out of a business’s own chimney versus electricity it buys from the grid. Investors watch Scope 1 because these direct emissions can create regulatory costs, operational changes, and reputational risks that affect profitability and long-term value.
scope 2technical
Scope 2 covers the greenhouse gas emissions produced indirectly when a business uses energy it buys from others—most commonly electricity, but also steam, heating or cooling. Think of it like the pollution linked to your household’s electricity bill: you didn’t burn the fuel yourself, but your consumption still causes emissions. Investors watch Scope 2 because it affects a company’s climate footprint, energy costs, regulatory exposure and reputation, all of which can influence long‑term financial performance.
scope 3technical
Scope 3 describes all greenhouse gas emissions that occur upstream and downstream of a company’s direct operations—things like emissions from suppliers, transportation, product use, and disposal. Think of it as the hidden carbon footprint tied to everything a business buys, sells, or enables; it matters to investors because these indirect emissions can drive regulatory costs, supply-chain disruption, consumer preference shifts, and long-term valuation risk that aren’t visible on a company’s factory floor or utility bill.
limited assuranceregulatory
An engagement where an independent auditor or reviewer provides moderate confidence that financial or non-financial information is free from material misstatement, but stops short of a full audit. Think of it as a focused check or review that uncovers obvious errors but does not involve the deep testing of a full audit. It matters to investors because it signals a lower level of independent verification of reported numbers, helping them judge how much trust to place in the disclosed information.

DOVER, USA, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- E-Power Inc. (“E-Power,” the “Company,” “we” or “our”) (NASDAQ: EPOW), a provider of advanced battery materials and AI Data Center (AIDC) microgrid solutions, today announced that its joint venture, Sunrise (Guizhou) New Energy Materials Co., Ltd. (“Sunrise Guizhou”), has been designated a national-level Specialized, Refined, Distinctive and Innovative (“Little Giant”) enterprise by China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (“MIIT”) as part of the MIIT’s eighth batch of Little Giant designations. Sunrise Guizhou received notice of the designation on October 14, 2026 through the MIIT’s High-Quality SME Gradient Cultivation Platform.

The designation completes the national review process described in the Company’s press release of August 20, 2026, which announced that Sunrise Guizhou had passed provincial review by the Department of Industry and Information Technology of Guizhou Province and was one of 28 enterprises included in the province’s recommendation list for the eighth batch.

The Top Tier of China’s SME Cultivation System

The MIIT’s gradient cultivation system for high-quality small and medium-sized enterprises (“SMEs”) has three tiers: technology-based and innovative SMEs; specialized and sophisticated SMEs, recognized at the provincial level; and Little Giant enterprises, designated at the national level by the MIIT. Only enterprises that already hold provincial specialized and sophisticated SME status may apply for Little Giant designation. The program recognizes SMEs that focus on specific market segments, possess core technologies and strong innovation capabilities, and hold leading positions in their segments.

Applications for the eighth batch were assessed under the MIIT’s revised Measures for the Administration of Gradient Cultivation of High-Quality Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises, issued in January 2026. According to the MIIT’s notice to Sunrise Guizhou, the designation followed preliminary review and recommendation by local authorities, expert review, and internal deliberation by the MIIT. The MIIT’s review uses staged review, random assignment of experts and review tasks, and blind review, and cross-checks application data using data analysis tools. The designation is valid for three years, from July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2029.

Progression Through All Three Tiers

Sunrise Guizhou has advanced through each tier of the system. It was recognized as an innovative SME in April 2023 and as a specialized and sophisticated SME in July 2024, and in May 2025 it was designated a Guizhou Province Key Specialized and Sophisticated SME. The Little Giant designation places it in the system’s top tier.

Sunrise Guizhou manufactures graphite anode materials and develops next-generation anode materials, including silicon-carbon composites and hard carbon for sodium-ion batteries. It was certified as a National High-Tech Enterprise in 2023. In 2024, one of its projects was selected through the “Open Competition” (Jie Bang Gua Shuai) mechanism of an MIIT industrial foundation innovation program and passed final acceptance in December 2024. In May 2025, it received an Excellence Award at the 25th China Patent Awards, granted by the China National Intellectual Property Administration, and in 2026 it participated in drafting the national standard “Porous Carbon for Silicon-Based Anode Materials” (Plan No. 20262157-T-605).

“This designation completes the national review that followed Guizhou’s provincial recommendation earlier this year, and we see it as recognition of our Guizhou team’s long-standing focus on anode materials,” said Mr. Haiping Hu, the founder, CEO and Chairman of E-Power Inc. “Because the designation is reviewed every three years, we intend to keep earning it through continued investment in research, standards work and manufacturing quality.”

About E-Power Inc.

E-Power Inc., through its subsidiaries, joint venture and variable interest entity structure, is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of graphite anode material for lithium-ion batteries. Through its joint venture, the Company operates a plant in Guizhou Province, China, powered by electricity from renewable sources, which contributes to the plant’s competitive production costs and reduced environmental impact in the production of graphite anode material. Mr. Haiping Hu, the founder, CEO and Chairman of the Company, has been a pioneer in the graphite anode industry since 1999. The Company’s management team is composed of experts with years of experience and successful track records in the graphite anode industry. Developed by Forbes and Statista, the ranking evaluates multinational organizations with at least 1,000 employees. The 2026 World's Best Employers list was developed by Statista and published in partnership with Forbes. The ranking is based on a proprietary methodology that evaluated multinational employers with at least 1,000 employees operating globally. The analysis incorporated independent survey responses from more than 300,000 employees and other respondents across more than 50 countries, collected from March through May in each of the last three years (2024-2026). Eligible companies were assessed based on direct evaluations from employees and indirect evaluations from respondents familiar with employers in their industry or through friends, family members, and acquaintances. Responses from all three years were included in the analysis, with greater weighting assigned to more recent responses. Eligible companies (those headquartered in the U.S. that generated over $100 million in revenue in 2024 or 2025) were evaluated across three key categories: employee satisfaction, revenue growth and sustainability transparency. The final ranking reflects the period from January 2026 to May 2026. Ameriprise did not pay a fee to be evaluated but did pay a fee to publicly cite the results.

Newsweek partnered with Plant-A Insights Group to recognize America’s Greatest Workplaces, chosen based on an independent survey of roughly 179,000 employees.
